blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A live-in couple was arrested after authorities seized an estimated P714,000 worth of suspected shabu during a buy-bust operation in Barangay Tisa, Cebu City, late Friday evening, October 2. The operation was conducted by the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency Regional Office 7 (PDEA-7) and the Labangon Police Station of the Cebu City Police Office at Sitio Caduloy at around 10:47 p.m. Live-in partners caught with shabu PDEA-7 identified the suspects as alias “Daday,” 32, who was the subject of the operation, and her live-in partner and alleged cohort, alias “Adriane,” 21.
